description: Rules 20 and 21 end to end through authorize(), signed and decided by the TypeScript reference; do not edit. Generated by packages/pca/scripts/gen-conformance-model-rules.mjs.

cases.name: tighten-quiet
cases.description: A tighten rule that does not fire: allowed, the tighten check passes.

cases.name: tighten-escalate
cases.description: A rule that fires with signal escalate: the decision is escalate (never allow).

reasons: tighten: escalate: asked by tighten rule 'big'

cases.name: tighten-deny
cases.description: A rule that fires with signal deny (and a reason): denied.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'cap' (over the cap)

cases.name: tighten-unknown-escalates
cases.description: A rule that reads a model value the verifier does not have is undecidable: escalate (never allow, never skipped).

reasons: tighten: escalate: rule 'hostile' could not be decided (a value it reads is missing or ill-typed)

cases.name: tighten-host-env-deny
cases.description: The host env carries env.judge.tone = hostile: the deny rule fires.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'hostile'

cases.name: tighten-host-env-clean
cases.description: The host env carries env.judge.tone = calm: the rule does not fire, allowed.

cases.name: tighten-v2-env-deny
cases.description: The v2 context env (no authorize context env) carries hostile: the deny rule fires.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'hostile'

cases.name: tighten-v2-env-wins
cases.description: The v2 context env wins over the authorize context env.

cases.name: tighten-meet
cases.description: An escalate rule then a deny rule: the outcome is the meet, the deny rule names the reason.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'hostile'

cases.name: tighten-deny-then-escalate
cases.description: A deny rule then an escalate rule: still deny, the first lowering rule names the reason.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'hostile'

cases.name: tighten-first-escalate-reason
cases.description: Two escalate rules fire: the first one names the reason.

reasons: tighten: escalate: asked by tighten rule 'big'

cases.name: model-path-in-where
cases.description: The grant allows an action only when a model-derived value is calm: a model could move a decision UP, so it is refused outright.

reasons: tighten: a grant's where reads model-derived path(s) env.judge.tone: a model may only tighten (move them into tighten[]) (rule 21)

cases.name: legacy-model-path
cases.description: model_polarity 'legacy' (signed in the envelope) lets the grant through, reported degraded.

degraded.tighten: model_polarity 'legacy': a grant reads a model-derived value in where (rule 21)

cases.name: legacy-strict-policy-overrides
cases.description: The verifier's policy.model_polarity 'strict' forbids it even for a 'legacy' envelope.

reasons: tighten: a grant's where reads model-derived path(s) env.judge.tone: a model may only tighten (move them into tighten[]) (rule 21)

cases.name: legacy-policy-accepts
cases.description: The verifier's policy.model_polarity 'legacy' accepts a grant that reads a model-derived path (degraded).

degraded.tighten: model_polarity 'legacy': a grant reads a model-derived value in where (rule 21)

cases.name: legacy-without-model-path
cases.description: model_polarity 'legacy' with nothing model-derived read: allowed and NOT degraded.

cases.name: model-path-other-root
cases.description: A where that reads a deterministic env member (env.acc) is not model-derived: allowed.

cases.name: legacy-with-rule
cases.description: Legacy compatibility still evaluates the grant's tighten rules.

reasons: tighten: denied by tighten rule 'hostile'

cases.name: context-bad-polarity
cases.description: policy.model_polarity must be strict or legacy: a malformed context fails closed.

reasons: schema: malformed v2 context: policy.model_polarity must be 'strict' or 'legacy'
intent_session: malformed v2 context: policy.model_polarity must be 'strict' or 'legacy'

cases.name: context-env-not-object
cases.description: The v2 context env must be an object: a malformed context fails closed.

reasons: schema: malformed v2 context: env must be an object
intent_session: malformed v2 context: env must be an object

cases.name: context-env-null
cases.description: The v2 context env must not be null.

reasons: tighten: escalate: asked by tighten rule 'big'

cases.name: units-match
cases.description: The policy tags amount as USD cents, the signed schema says USD cents: allowed.

cases.name: units-cents-vs-dollars
cases.description: The policy tags amount as whole USD, the schema says USD cents: refused (unit confusion).

reasons: units: 'action.params.amount' is declared as money/USD/e2 by the action schema but the policy term is tagged money/USD/e0 (unit confusion)

cases.name: units-currency-mismatch
cases.description: The policy tags amount as EUR cents: refused.

reasons: units: 'action.params.amount' is declared as money/USD/e2 by the action schema but the policy term is tagged money/EUR/e2 (unit confusion)

cases.name: units-no-exponent
cases.description: The policy tag omits the exponent the schema declares: refused.

reasons: units: 'action.params.amount' is declared as money/USD/e2 by the action schema but the policy term is tagged money/USD (unit confusion)

cases.name: units-no-schema
cases.description: A grant with unit tags and a verifier with no action schema: refused (units cannot be checked).

reasons: units: this verifier has no action schema configured

cases.name: units-untagged-term
cases.description: A where term reads the unit-bearing amount without a unit tag: refused.

reasons: units: a policy term reads 'action.params.amount' (money/USD/e2) without a unit tag

cases.name: units-tagged-term
cases.description: The same term with its unit tag: allowed.

cases.name: units-undeclared-param-ignored
cases.description: A tag for a parameter the verb does not declare is ignored.

cases.name: units-hard-and-tighten-escalate
cases.description: A unit confusion (hard) and a tighten escalation: the decision is deny, both reasons are reported in pipeline order.

reasons: units: 'action.params.amount' is declared as money/USD/e2 by the action schema but the policy term is tagged money/USD/e0 (unit confusion)
tighten: escalate: asked by tighten rule 'big'

reasons: tighten: escalate: asked by tighten rule 'big'
